name: @kajidog/mcp-tts-voicevox

tools.name: voicevox_ping
tools.description: Check if VOICEVOX Engine is running and reachable

tools.name: voicevox_stop_speaker
tools.description: Stop current audio playback

tools.name: voicevox_get_speakers
tools.description: Get a list of available speakers. The returned "speaker" field is the exact ID to pass to speak.speaker

tools.name: voicevox_speak
tools.description: Play text as speech immediately. Use this for simple TTS — no UI, no editing. If you need a player UI or want to edit/replay segments, use voicevox_speak_player instead.

text.description:
Text split by line breaks (
). IMPORTANT: Each line = one speech unit (processed and played separately). Keep the FIRST LINE SHORT for quick playback start - audio begins as soon as the first line is synthesized. Example: "Hi!
This is a longer explanation that follows." Optional speaker prefix per line: "1:Hello
2:World". Time-like lines such as "10:30..." are read as-is, not treated as a speaker prefix.

phrases.description: Inline accent notation (e.g. "コン[ニ]チワ,セ[カ]イ"). Brackets mark accent position. Takes priority over query and text.

immediate.description: If true, stops current playback and plays new audio immediately. If false, waits for current playback to finish. Default depends on environment variable.

waitForStart.description: Wait for playback to start (optional, default: false)

waitForEnd.description: Wait for playback to end (optional, default: false)

tools.name: voicevox_synthesize_file
tools.description: Generate an audio file and return its absolute path

output.description: Output path for the audio file

tools.name: voicevox_get_accent_phrases
tools.description: Get accent phrases (reading and accent positions) from text. Returns inline notation like "コン[ニ]チワ,セ[カ]イ" where brackets indicate accent position.

tools.name: voicevox_get_user_dictionary
tools.description: Get words in the VOICEVOX user dictionary. Supports filtering by query and pagination. Pronunciation uses inline accent notation (e.g. "ボイス[ボッ]クス").

query.description: Filter by surface or pronunciation (partial match, case-insensitive)

tools.name: voicevox_add_user_dictionary_word
tools.description: Add a word to the VOICEVOX user dictionary. Pronunciation supports inline accent notation (e.g. "ボイス[ボッ]クス"). If brackets are omitted, accent is auto-estimated.

surface.description: Word surface form (the text to match)

pronunciation.description: Katakana reading with optional inline accent notation (e.g. "ボイス[ボッ]クス")

tools.name: voicevox_update_user_dictionary_word
tools.description: Update a word in the VOICEVOX user dictionary. surface and pronunciation are optional — omitted fields keep their existing values. Pronunciation supports inline accent notation.

surface.description: Word surface form (omit to keep existing)

pronunciation.description: Katakana reading with optional inline accent notation (omit to keep existing)

tools.name: voicevox_delete_user_dictionary_word
tools.description: Delete a word from the VOICEVOX user dictionary.

tools.name: voicevox_add_user_dictionary_words
tools.description: Add multiple words to the VOICEVOX user dictionary at once. Pronunciation supports inline accent notation.

pronunciation.description: Katakana reading with optional inline accent notation

tools.name: voicevox_update_user_dictionary_words
tools.description: Update multiple words in the VOICEVOX user dictionary at once. surface and pronunciation are optional per word — omitted fields keep existing values.

surface.description: Word surface form (omit to keep existing)

pronunciation.description: Katakana reading with optional inline accent notation (omit to keep existing)

tools.name: voicevox_open_dictionary_ui
tools.description: Open the user dictionary manager UI for VOICEVOX.

tools.name: voicevox_speak_player
tools.description: Use when you need a player UI (display, edit, or replay audio). Creates a VOICEVOX player session, returns viewUUID. Multi-speaker format: "1:Hello\n2:World". For simple playback without UI, use voicevox_speak instead.

text.description: Text to synthesize. Multi-speaker format: "1:Hello\n2:World" (speaker ID prefix per line).

tools.name: voicevox_resynthesize_player
tools.description: Edit one player track by index. Requires viewUUID from speak_player/resynthesize_player. Returns new viewUUID.

tools.name: _get_speakers_for_player
tools.description: Get speaker list for the player UI. This tool is only callable from the app UI.

tools.name: _get_speaker_icon_for_player
tools.description: Get speaker portrait icon by UUID. Only callable from the app UI.

tools.name: _get_player_state_for_player
tools.description: Fetch full player segments (including audioQuery/accentPhrases) for a viewUUID. Only callable from the app UI.

viewUUID.description: Player instance ID from the tool result text

tools.name: _save_player_state_for_player
tools.description: Persist current player segments to server state without synthesizing audio. Only callable from the app UI.

viewUUID.description: Player instance ID to associate this state with

segments.description: Full current player segment list to persist

tools.name: _resynthesize_for_player
tools.description: Re-synthesize audio with a different speaker or updated parameters. Only callable from the app UI.

viewUUID.description: Player instance ID to associate this synthesis with

speaker.description: Speaker ID (uses server default if omitted)

audioQuery.description: Audio query to synthesize from (preferred over text parameters)

speedScale.description: Playback speed (uses server default if omitted)

pauseLengthScale.description: Pause length scale between phrases 間の長さ (optional)

autoPlay.description: Auto-play audio when loaded (uses server config if omitted)

segmentIndex.description: Segment index for single-segment state update

persistState.description: Persist player state to server store (default: true)

segments.description: All current player segments — pass the full list to update server state

tools.name: _get_user_dictionary_for_player
tools.description: Get VOICEVOX user dictionary words for the dictionary manager UI.

tools.name: _add_user_dictionary_word_for_player
tools.description: Add a word to VOICEVOX user dictionary.

accentType.description: Accent nucleus position (1-based mora index, 0=flat). Auto-estimated if omitted.

tools.name: _update_user_dictionary_word_for_player
tools.description: Update a VOICEVOX user dictionary word.

accentType.description: Accent nucleus position (1-based mora index, 0=flat). Auto-estimated if omitted.

tools.name: _delete_user_dictionary_word_for_player
tools.description: Delete a VOICEVOX user dictionary word.

tools.name: _preview_dictionary_word_for_player
tools.description: Preview pronunciation with a random speaker.

accentType.description: Optional accent nucleus position for the first phrase (1-based mora index, 0=flat).

tools.name: _get_export_capability_for_player
tools.description: Return whether track export + folder open is available for player UI.

tools.name: _select_directory_for_player
tools.description: Open a native OS directory picker dialog, to be called from the player UI.

tools.name: _export_tracks_for_player
tools.description: Save player tracks as wav files and open the target folder in file explorer.

tools.name: voicevox_get_player_state
tools.description: Read current player state (segments, accent phrases). Use latest viewUUID from speak_player/resynthesize_player. If hasMore is true, call again with nextCursor.

viewUUID.description: Player instance ID from speak_player/resynthesize_player. Always pass the latest viewUUID.

limit.description: Max segments per page (default: 100, max: 1000). Server may return fewer segments when needed.
